title: nodePortAddresses should be set explicitly

detection.reason: the recommendation is about a flag that is ABSENT, and absence of an arg cannot be told apart from a value set in the config file the projection does not carry

quote: This is strongly recommended, if you were not previously using --nodeport-addresses, to avoid surprising behavior.
remediation: Set `nodePortAddresses` to `primary` unless you deliberately want NodePort connections accepted on every address of every node. Leaving it unset keeps the old listen-on-everything behaviour on iptables and ipvs, which is the surprising case upstream is warning about.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("kube-proxy")) | .metadata.name + ": " + ([.spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]? | select(test("nodeport-addresses"))] | join(" ") | if . == "" then "--nodeport-addresses NOT set" else . end)'  # says whether the flag is set on the kube-proxy DaemonSet

title: Node .status.kubeProxyVersion no longer set by default

detection.reason: the field's presence on Node status today does not say what it will be after the upgrade — the gate is kubelet process configuration, which is not collected

quote: Graduated the `DisableNodeKubeProxyVersion` feature gate to beta. By default, the kubelet no longer attempts to set the `.status.kubeProxyVersion` field for its associated Node.
remediation: The gate is beta and ON at 1.31, so the field stops being populated on upgraded nodes by default. Fix readers of `.status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion` before the hop, not after.
verifyCommand: kubectl get nodes -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion != null) | "\(.metadata.name) \(.status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion)"'  # each node printed still publishes the field; it stops being set after the upgrade

title: nftables mode requires nft 1.0.1 and kernel 5.13

detection.reason: read from the kube-proxy ConfigMap's own mode field; the node's nft version and kernel version are host state and are not collected

quote: The (alpha) nftables mode of kube-proxy now requires version 1.0.1 or later of the nft command-line, and kernel 5.13 or later.
remediation: This cluster runs the nftables mode, so the node requirement applies: nft 1.0.1+ and kernel 5.13+. Check the node image before upgrading — kube-proxy refuses to start on an older kernel unless `nftables.skipKernelVersionCheck` is set, which upstream does not recommend in production.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get cm -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("kube-proxy")) | (.data // {}) | to_entries[] | .value | scan("(?m)^ *mode: *\"?([a-z]+)") | .[0]'  # prints the configured kube-proxy mode; nftables means the node nft/kernel floor applies
